name: equilibrator
title: Showcase: viva-equilibrator — eQuilibrator ΔG' as a pluggable thermodynamics engine
description: viva-equilibrator bridges the eQuilibrator API (component-contribution ΔG' estimation) into process-bigraph as a reusable thermodynamics Step. This showcase runs the engine on the origin-of-life question of whether early carbon-fixation chemistry is thermodynamically favorable at vent conditions: the feasibility-gate composite computes ΔG' for three reductive CO2-fixation products and emits a per-reaction feasibility flag.
question: Does viva-equilibrator expose the real eQuilibrator (component-contribution) engine as a process-bigraph Step that computes transformed Gibbs free energies and reports reaction feasibility under defined environmental conditions?
hypothesis: Wrapping eQuilibrator as a process-bigraph Step and feeding it a fixed alkaline-hydrothermal-vent condition should report that H2-driven reductive CO2-fixation reactions (to formate, acetate, pyruvate) are strongly exergonic (ΔG' < 0) — opening a thermodynamic feasibility gate — using genuine component-contribution estimates, computed entirely offline.

executive.what_is_this: A demonstration that the eQuilibrator thermodynamics calculator can be driven as a plug-in engine inside process-bigraph. It takes a set of vent conditions (pH, temperature, dissolved H2 and CO2) and reports, with real published free-energy data, whether three candidate carbon-fixation reactions can run downhill.
executive.verdict: The feasibility-gate composite runs eQuilibrator end to end and finds all three reductive CO2-fixation reactions strongly exergonic at vent conditions (ΔG' = -48.7, -150.7, -88.3 kJ/mol), with feasibility ~1.0 — both acceptance bands met in a clean-venv run of the pinned engine.
executive.verdict_detail: Study vent-feasibility-gate: at pH 9.5 / 333.15 K / H2 5e-3 M / CO2 2e-3 M, eQuilibrator reports ΔG'(formate) = -48.66, ΔG'(acetate) = -150.74, ΔG'(pyruvate) = -88.28 kJ/mol; every reaction feasibility >= 0.9999 (observed on viva-equilibrator 0.1.0 / equilibrator-api 0.8.1, 2026-11-27, fully offline).

scientific_argument.main_claim: eQuilibrator's component-contribution ΔG' estimation can be exposed as a reusable process-bigraph Step that evaluates reaction feasibility under defined conditions using genuine thermodynamic data.
evidence_for: All three reductive CO2-fixation reactions come back exergonic (ΔG' < 0) at the vent condition, matching the expectation that an H2-rich alkaline vent is a thermodynamically permissive environment for early carbon fixation.
The ΔG' values carry real component-contribution uncertainties and match the engine's own standard_dg_prime helper, so they are genuine eQuilibrator output.
evidence_against: This is a feasibility gate at a single fixed condition, not a flux or kinetic prediction; thermodynamic favorability is necessary but not sufficient for a pathway to carry flux.
caveats: The engine runs offline from the shipped component-contribution cache (equilibrator-cache-data); results are the cache's current best estimates.

studies.title: Vent carbon-fixation feasibility gate (eQuilibrator ΔG')
studies.question: Driven as a process-bigraph Step, does eQuilibrator report H2-driven reductive CO2 fixation to formate, acetate and pyruvate as thermodynamically feasible at alkaline-hydrothermal-vent conditions?

findings.name: exergonic-carbon-fixation
